Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by misidentifying the subject of the query. The user asked about the performer of the song "Goosebumpz." The Planner incorrectly interpreted "Goosebumpz" as the name of an artist (believing it was a performer named Goosebumpz) rather than recognizing it as a song title performed by Mac Miller. This fundamental misunderstanding led to a flawed initial strategy where the Planner attempted to find the release date of "Best Day Ever" by a non-existent artist named "Goosebumpz," rather than correctly identifying Mac Miller as the artist first and then finding his "Best Day Ever" release date. Although the WebSurfer later corrected this factual error in its own search results, the Planner's initial analysis and decision-making process were based on a false premise from the very beginning.
